newsitem.title: USA: Midland Loan acquires mortgage servicing rights.
newsitem.headline: Midland Loan acquires mortgage servicing rights.

text.p: Midland Loan Services LP said Friday it agreed to acquire the servicing rights to a large portfolio of commercial and multi-family mortgage and related assets from NationsBank Corp.

The total servicing portfolio, which has principal balances of $4.2 billion, is currently serviced by Boatmen's National Mortgage, a subsidiary of Boatmen's Bancshares Inc, which merged in January with NationsBank.
Midland and NationsBank also announced they would form a strategic alliance to securitize jointly commercial mortgages originated by each party.

In connection with these transactions, NationsBank will also acquire about a five percent interest in Midland. The companies said this will not result in a change of control or strategic focus for Midland.

In the transaction, Midland will acquire the servicing rights to approximately 900 commercial and multi-family loans. Certain of the servicing rights require consent of the loan owners or approvals by third parties, such as rating agencies, before they can be transferred to Midland.
Upon closing, Midland will service $17 billion in commercial mortgage-backed securities loans, or a 17 percent market share. The transaction is expected to close within 90 days.
